# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-25

This transitional Xteink X4 Pro release moves over-the-air updates to the CrossPoint self-hosted release service while retaining GitHub as a temporary fallback.

## Changed

- Added the self-hosted CrossPoint release feed as the primary OTA source.
- Retained GitHub Releases as a fallback while existing X4 Pro devices migrate to the new updater.
- Added a model-aware publishing format so future releases can carry separate firmware images for multiple devices.

## Fixed

- Fixed compilation of compact settings menus that use Lucide icons.
- Fixed X4 Pro reader title handling in the shared status bar.

## Notes

- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 Pro only.
- Future releases can be delivered without publishing firmware through GitHub after devices have installed this transitional version.
